title: VespaDocumentStructure
description: Structural breakdown of a Vespa document for the /document/v1 API.

fields.<fieldName>: value — type defined by the schema (string, int, double, tensor, array, weightedset, map, struct, document reference)

<fieldName>.increment: number — atomic add to numeric field
<fieldName>.decrement: number — atomic subtract from numeric field
<fieldName>.multiply: number — atomic multiply for numeric field
<fieldName>.divide: number — atomic divide for numeric field

VespaVisitResponse.documentCount: integer — number of documents in this batch
VespaVisitResponse.continuation: string — token to pass to the next visit request
